name: Twenty
one_liner: Open-source CRM (twenty.com) with schema-generated REST and GraphQL APIs, available as managed cloud or self-hosted.
auth_notes: API key as Bearer token from Settings > Developers > API; OAuth 2.0 auth code+PKCE and client credentials. Outbound webhooks signed with HMAC SHA256 (X-Twenty-Webhook-Signature).
access_notes: Cloud: 30-day trial, no credit card; Pro $9/user/mo includes REST & GraphQL API, webhooks, MCP. Self-hosting the open-source core is free. API is not plan-gated, only rate limited (50/min Pro, 100/min Organization, custom Enterprise).

buildability.rationale: Self-serve API keys and OAuth on cloud trial or free self-host; documented REST/GraphQL with signed webhooks. API is per-workspace schema-generated, so tool definitions must be built dynamically.

needs_human_reason: MCP endpoint URL not found in fetched pages; no static OpenAPI spec (schema is per workspace).

evidence.quote: Sign up for Cloud in under a minute and start your 30-day trial.
Self-hosting the open source core is free.
Twenty sends an HTTP POST to your URL whenever a record is created, updated, or deleted.
Every Cloud workspace ships with a native MCP server.

disputes.why: Pricing page shows 30-day trial, API included on all plans, free self-host.
Webhooks doc exists with HMAC-signed payloads for all record events.
API docs list 100 per minute; pricing lists 50 per minute on Pro.
Pricing lists Local and Production environments; self-hostable.
Plan gating resolved: API on all plans, MCP on cloud, self-serve.
